points: Building financial infrastructure that makes capital more productive — stablecoin liquidity and settlement, asset tokenisation, onchain capital markets, and agentic finance.
Leading strategy, product, and partnerships with banks, asset managers, enterprise treasuries, payment providers, and VASPs.
Advising fintechs on deploying stablecoin settlement across African markets — licensing, FX dynamics, counterparty risk, and jurisdictional compliance.
Co-leading digital-asset strategy and tokenised product development, from institutional client acquisition to treasury operations across stablecoin and fiat liquidity.
Researching VASP frameworks and licensing pathways, and working with regulators on how digital-asset policy gets designed and implemented.
Built one of Africa's most recognised digital-asset media and research platforms — hosting, producing, writing, and editing the podcast and newsletter end to end.
Interviewed global industry leaders, including the CEO of Tether, for listeners in more than 100 countries.
Convened fintechs, builders, regulators, and institutions across Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, and South Africa — and onboarded thousands into the digital-asset economy.
Designed a digital-asset-native funding mechanism for public goods across Africa that helped more than 50 impact projects secure grant funding.
Project Manager, Guild Coordinator, Governance Lead, and Grants Committee member — running a decentralised institution without a head office.
Evaluated funding proposals, shaped treasury allocation, and oversaw funded initiatives on the Grants Committee.
Ran New Joiner Sessions for about 18 months, onboarding contributors into the DAO.
Advised digital-native organisations on treasury, liquidity, staking economics, and tokenomics.
Built an agency banking and mobile money network of 10 service locations across Ghanaian cities — bringing deposits, withdrawals, and cash-in/cash-out closer to people banks don't reach.
Partnered with Fidelity Bank for agency banking, extending service to customers of other major banks and Ghana's mobile money networks.
Wore four hats at once — project coordinator, logistics manager, accountant, and board secretary.
